idea-plugin.name: TidyKit
idea-plugin.description:
文本格式化工具箱 / Text formatting toolkit.
所有功能以标签页承载于同一工具窗口，结果一键复制。All features open as tabs in one tool window, results one-click copyable.

- JSON格式化：大纲风格树视图，严格/宽松解析，转义 JSON 自动解开，查找高亮，右键复制子树。
  JSON Formatter: outline-style tree view, strict / lenient parsing, escaped-JSON extraction, search & highlight, right-click subtree copy.
- JSON对比：按 key 路径做结构化语义比对，合成差异树，支持仅展示差异。
  JSON Diff: structural comparison by key path, merged diff tree, show-differences-only filter.
- URL编码/解码：百分号编解码，固定 UTF-8，宽松解码。
  URL Codec: percent encode / decode, fixed UTF-8, lenient decoding.
- HTML格式化：宽松重排缩进，属性顺序/引号/标签大小写照搬。
  HTML Formatter: lenient re-indenting, keeps attribute order / quotes / tag case as-is.
- XML格式化：严格重排缩进，报错带行列号，安全处理不加载外部 DTD/实体。
  XML Formatter: strict re-indenting with line / column errors, secure processing (no external DTD / entities).
- SQL参数格式化：GORM 日志参数回填 ? 占位符（智能加引号），可选关键字换行美化且内容无损。
  SQL Param Formatter: bind GORM log parameters back into ? placeholders (smart quoting), optional keyword re-indenting that never changes token content.
